analysis: The PR touches only two docs files: docs/architecture/inference.md (a new paragraph at head lines 85-91 on out-of-order performance-measurement freshness) and docs/developer/test.md (a new EngineMeasurementOrderingTests section, patch hunk at head lines 347-362). No source code, keys, attestation, encryption or authorization logic changed. I checked the changes against the threat model (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011, T-041) and found no regressions. The unit text for inference.md is the large unchanged remainder, covering MTP, prefix cache, MiMo and Qwen4 documentation. The new freshness paragraph itself (lines 85-91) is outside the supplied head-text units and appears only in the patch excerpt. That text says only that rate age and expiry follow the newest observation and that a heartbeat snapshot alone never renews evidence. Nothing in it changes security semantics, and it does not touch the cache scope, TTL, or SSD encryption posture of T-041. Performance measurements feed capacity and routing evidence that the coordinator consumes. The claim that evidence freshness is monotonic is a documented contract only; the actual EnginePerformanceMeasurements implementation was not in the supplied evidence. I treat that as an unverified contract, not a finding. The test doc explicitly disclaims qualifying live inference or coordinator routing. The unit 67373c0eff1153bd:0 is metadata only, with no text. No documented security claim was newly weakened or overclaimed.
